features.title: Skilled leader
features.text: Envoys lead through words and example. They have many skills, with particular strength in persuading people or talking the party out of trouble.

features.title: Directives
features.text: Issue one directive each round to help allies attack or defend. Take its linked action to lead by example and strengthen the effect.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 2.5–3.5 → 2.5–3.5. Leadership styles can emphasize personal attacks, but ally-enabled damage primarily counts as support.
ratings.defense: 2.5 → 2.5. Eight HP and light armor favor positioning over absorbing attacks.
ratings.support: 5 → 4–5. Directives and leadership abilities improve allies' turns and coordinate the team.
ratings.utility: 4.5 → 4.5. Charisma, skills and social tools make interaction a defining strength.
ratings.difficulty: 3 → 3. Time directives and select when to lead with an action.
